meta_description: 738K likes, 1,423 comments - lewishamilton on October 8, 2026: "SINGAPORE 🇸🇬 Thanks so much for all the love so far. I hope everyone’s enjoying the @plus44world pop up and the Orbit 44 gallery exhibition. I’ve always admired @jahan_’s art, so collaborating with him on this collection is super exciting. I’m grateful for the opportunity to see his work in person. The scale and the detail in his work, the time that goes into hand painting and hand sculpting, it’s incredible. If you’ve not been yet, make sure you stop by @marinabaysands to check them both out ~".
